blocks.text: Interior design, custom furniture, and turnkey renovation in Ukraine

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers a full cycle of services in Ukraine: interior design, architecture, custom furniture, turnkey renovation, and procurement. One team runs the project from the first consultation to the handover of the keys, so you don’t have to find and coordinate separate contractors.

Our portfolio includes private houses in Kyiv (217 m²) and Kharkiv (212 m²) completed on a turnkey basis, apartments in Kyiv, a clothing boutique, and a barbershop facade. You can order the design project on its own or together with its implementation.

items: Consultation. We discuss your project by phone, messenger, or video call. The consultation is free.
Measurements. We record the dimensions, utilities, and specific features of the rooms on site.
Concept and 3D. Layout options, style, materials, and photorealistic visualizations. We agree on revisions with you.
Documentation and estimate. Drawings for the builders and for furniture production, specifications, and a renovation cost estimate.
Implementation. Furniture production, renovation, installation, and procurement — by one team, on an agreed schedule.
Handover. Final assembly, installation of lighting and plumbing fixtures, cleaning, and handing over the keys.

parts.html: If you are currently abroad, the project can be managed remotely: we agree on the concept, visualizations, and progress of the work online.

blocks.text: Cost of the design project and renovation

parts.html: The cost of the design project depends on the package — from “Express” to “Premium+”; package contents and prices are on the pricing page.
We calculate the cost of furniture and renovation based on the project and the estimate. The first consultation is free.

items.q: Can I order just the design project?
items.a: Yes. You will receive visualizations and working drawings that any construction crew can work from. Implementation — furniture and renovation — can be ordered from us right away or later.

items.q: Can the project be managed if I live abroad?
items.a: Yes. Consultations and approval of the concept, 3D visualizations, and progress of the work all happen online. We work on site, and you make the key decisions remotely.

items.q: How long does a design project take?
items.a: “Express” takes from 14 days; a full design project usually takes 4–8 weeks. We give timelines for renovation and furniture production once the estimate is ready.
